The '''Black Sands Cantina''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] where the [[Tiss'shar/Legends|Tiss'shar]] [[Gunslinger/Legends|gunslinger]] [[Uul-Rha-Shan]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] the [[Socorran]] gunslinger [[Neena Garnet]] over a bar tab.
